Definition: from G303 and G2224; to gird afresh:--gird up.
BiblicalUsage: Peter tells his readers to gird up the loins of their mind, be sober, and hope to the end. The picture comes from a man tucking up his long robe so he can run or work without tripping, applied to the mind getting ready for what is coming.
TheologicalSignificance: One call to gird up the mind carries no system of its own; its force is Peter's, that hope is not daydreaming but a mind made ready to run.
